about_the_game:
Imagine a student who spends all his free time on the computer, and if he's not playing games, he's watching porn and masturbating.
No girlfriend, no job, studies abandoned, and a looming expulsion from college. That's the character you have to play.

You live in the same house with three sexy beauties.
Do you think this makes your life pleasurable? Quite the opposite!
One of them despises you, the second is constantly trolling you, and the third treats you like a child.
Everything changes after an unfortunate incident and a sudden large financial debt.
You decide to change yourself and your life.
But is it that simple? How much will you need to change yourself to become what you've never been?


"How to Lose One's Virginity" is a visual novel telling a story of difficult success:
  • Over 5000 static images in 4K resolution, converted to UltraHD for the best picture quality.
  • Over 100 animated scenes.
  • 5-6 hours of gameplay.
  • A story with transformation, intrigues, and difficult decisions at the end of the game.
  • Plenty of lewd scenes with various girls
  • Girls with dissimilar and memorable characters. By the way, their figures are also different ;)

Take Control of Your Life and Improve Yourself!


Get a Job and Make Friends!


Improve Your Relationships At Home!


Learn to Communicate with Different Women!
